svg.title: Grepleaks terminal demo
svg.desc: The Grepleaks home screen: 120+ pentest skills, 900+ pentest tools. The composer cycles the built-in pentest prompts, then a recon prompt is submitted and the agent plans, runs subfinder, reviews discovered hosts and writes a report under /engagement.
